Item.Key: Four on the floor — Euclidean hats

Preset.Comment: Steady 4/16 kick and backbeat snare under an E(11,16) closed-hat groove with swung open-hat and rim accents.
Twelve-step bell timeline E(7,12) on cowbell interlocked with 3/12 kick, 5/12 rim, low tom and hats.
Syncopated E(5,16) rim timeline over 3/16 kick, backbeat snare, off-beat claps, dense hats and low tom.
Six polymetric percussion lanes driven by per-hit chance, 15 % fill and subtle timing and velocity humanize.
Asymmetric E(5,8) hat and rim propulsion locked against 10-step kick and snare phrases.
Swung four-on-the-floor foundation with rapid 2x to 4x ratcheting hi-hat and clap flurries.
Interlocking 3, 4 and 5 pulse counts across 10, 12, 15, 16 and 20 step rings with a half-time high tom.
Six minor-pentatonic notes across polymetric step rings and dividers, ready to drive Neo Poly or any synth.
